messages.settings.integratedTerminalShellDescript: Applies to new sessions only. On Windows, Bash uses this shell; Auto tries Git Bash, then cmd.exe.
messages.settings.nativeSearchEnhancementsDescrip: Use enhanced Find and Grep in new sessions and sessions restored after an app restart. Active sessions keep their current setting; Find remains unchanged on Windows.
messages.settings.memoryDescription: The in-app agent keeps short notes about each project (commands, conventions, what to avoid) and reads them when a new session starts. Adds a few model requests.
messages.settings.memory.viewer.localOnly: Memory details are available only in the local desktop app. Open Memory settings there to view them.
messages.settings.memory.viewer.title: Saved workspace memories
messages.settings.memory.viewer.description: Browse memories saved by workspace on this device.
messages.settings.memory.viewer.projectsDescripti: Select a project to view all of its saved memories.
messages.settings.memory.viewer.empty: No notes yet. They appear after the agent learns something lasting about a project, or when you say “remember that …” in a chat.
messages.settings.memory.viewer.fileDeleted: This memory file has been deleted. Refresh the file list to update it.
messages.settings.memory.viewer.fileTooLarge: This memory file exceeds the 5 MiB preview limit.
messages.settings.memory.viewer.fileChanged: This memory file was updated while being read. Reopen it or refresh the file list.
messages.settings.memory.viewer.noSelection: Select a memory file to preview it.
messages.settings.httpProxyDescription: Route model, MCP, command-tool, and app renderer egress traffic through this proxy; system environment variables are not read. Leave blank and that traffic connects directly, while the embedded browser follows your system proxy settings. Restart the app to take effect.
messages.settings.httpProxyPlaceholder: Blank means the embedded browser follows the system proxy, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890
messages.settings.httpProxyNoProxyDescription: Requests matching these hosts connect directly instead of using the HTTP proxy. Separate rules with commas. Restart the app to take effect.
messages.settings.httpProxyCaCertPathDescription: Optional. Set a PEM root certificate path to inject it as NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS for models, MCP, and command tools, and to trust it in renderer certificate verification. Restart the app to take effect.
messages.settings.httpProxySavedHint: Network proxy settings saved. Restart the app to take effect.
messages.settings.desktopChromiumHardwareAccelera: Turn this off to work around blank windows, crashes, or rendering issues caused by some GPUs or drivers. Restart the app to take effect.
Chrome hardware acceleration setting saved. Restart the app to take effect.
messages.settings.receivePreviewUpdatesDescriptio: When enabled, you will get the earliest access to new features and improvements. When disabled, you will receive update pushes according to the regular release schedule.
messages.settings.autoDownloadAndInstallUpdatesDe: When enabled, updates start downloading as soon as they are found. Restart still requires confirmation when tasks are running.
messages.settings.notificationDescription: Send desktop notifications when a task completes, fails, or needs approval.
messages.settings.notificationSoundDescription: When notifications are enabled, you can mute the task notification sound separately.
messages.settings.zaicodeSound.failed: This sound could not be played.
messages.zaicode.settings.autoSessionTitleHint: Name the active session after the latest NEXT EXACT ACTION. On by default.
messages.settings.closeToTrayOnWindows: Hide to tray when closing window
messages.settings.closeToTrayOnWindowsDescription: Windows only. The close button and close-window shortcut hide the window, while Quit from the tray still exits the app.
messages.settings.keepAwakeWhileRunningDescriptio: Prevent the system from sleeping due to idle. You can still sleep manually or by closing the lid. Desktop only.
messages.settings.messageStreamShowReasoningDescr: Show full reasoning inside the message stream. When off, the first reasoning item in each turn remains visible.
messages.settings.messageStreamShowTodosDescripti: Show Todo tool cards inside the message stream.
messages.settings.toolGroupingExploreDescription: Group consecutive reads and searches into an Explore section.
messages.settings.toolGroupingTerminalDescription: Group consecutive non-read-only shell commands into a Terminal section.
messages.settings.toolGroupingChangesDescription: Group consecutive Write, Edit, and ApplyPatch calls into a Changes section.
messages.settings.zcodeInteractionBehaviorDescrip: While ZAICODE is running, add follow-up actions to the queue or guide them to run after the next tool call.
messages.settings.askUserQuestionAutoResolutionDe: When enabled, Agent questions automatically continue after 5 minutes without an answer. When disabled, current and future questions wait for your response.
messages.settings.modelIoFullRetentionDescription: Keep complete model requests and responses without compression, size limits, or automatic deletion.
messages.settings.performanceModeDescription: Simplify rendered output to improve performance.
messages.settings.taskAutoArchiveDescription: Periodically scan recently opened workspaces and automatically archive completed, unread-free, unpinned tasks after the retention window.
messages.settings.taskAutoArchiveDaysDescription: A task becomes eligible for auto-archive only after its last update is older than this window.
messages.settings.dataBaseDirDescription: Root directory for app data (defaults to user home directory). Existing data will be copied to the new location. The .zcode/v2 suffix cannot be changed.
